title: Sr Executive - Talent Acquisition
description:
**About Us:**

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
**Note:** The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented **Senior Executive - Talent Acquisition** to manage end-to-end recruitment activities across multiple business functions. The incumbent will be responsible for sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, stakeholder management, and ensuring timely closure of positions while delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Recruitment & Hiring**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment lifecycle from requisition receipt to candidate onboarding.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, databases, and networking.
* Screen resumes and conduct preliminary interviews to assess candidate suitability.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers and business leaders.
* Manage offer discussions, salary negotiations, and offer rollouts.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements and hiring priorities.
* Provide regular recruitment updates and market intelligence to stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders to ensure effective manpower planning.

### **Sourcing & Talent Mapping**

* Develop talent pipelines for current and future hiring requirements.
* Conduct market mapping and competitor analysis to identify talent availability.
* Leverage LinkedIn and other professional networks for passive candidate sourcing.

### **Recruitment Operations**

* Maintain recruitment trackers and ATS records with high data accuracy.
* Ensure compliance with internal recruitment policies and processes.
* Generate recruitment reports and dashboards on hiring metrics.

### **Employer Branding**

* Participate in recruitment drives, job fairs, and campus hiring initiatives.
* Promote employer brand through social media and candidate engagement activities.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Time-to-Fill
* Position Closure Rate
* Offer-to-Join Ratio
* Candidate Experience Score
* Stakeholder Satisfaction
* Cost-per-Hire
* Recruitment SLA Adherence

**Desired Candidate Profile**
-----------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

### **Experience**

* 3-6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition.
* Experience in bulk hiring, lateral hiring, and stakeholder management.
* Exposure to healthcare, RCM, ITES, BPO, KPO, or technology hiring preferred.

### **Skills Required**

* Strong sourcing and screening capabilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Negotiation and influencing skills.
* Expertise in LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and other sourcing platforms.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and ATS tools.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Result Orientation
* Customer Centricity
* Ownership & Accountability
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Problem Solving
* Adaptability & Agility

### **Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work in a fast-paced and growth-oriented environment.
* Exposure to leadership hiring and strategic talent initiatives.
* Career progression within Talent Acquisition and HR functions.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**  
**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.  
A job description is only intended as a guideline and is only part of the Team Member’s function. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that the essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

Interested candidates can share resume at tanya.yadav@rcvtechnologies.com.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Every day, millions of vehicle owners depend on dealership service departments to keep them on the road. We build the software that helps those service teams communicate with customers, schedule repairs, approve work, collect payments, and deliver a better experience from start to finish.


myKaarma is a leading SaaS platform serving dealerships across North America. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, with a global team, we're growing by solving real operational problems with practical technology.


We believe the best ideas come from people who take ownership, question how things can be improved, and care deeply about the customer experience. If you're excited to build products that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

 **Role Description:**  

myKaarma is looking for a hands\-on Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to help us identify and hire exceptional talent as we continue to grow in India.


This role is well suited for someone who combines the energy and execution needed for high\-volume recruiting with the judgment, organization, and technical fluency required to recruit for a growing software company. You will own searches from initial planning through offer acceptance while also building scalable programs for campus hiring, employee referrals, interview events, and candidate assessment.


The right person is a strong recruiter and project manager; someone who can turn a hiring goal into a clear plan, coordinate many moving pieces, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and create an excellent candidate experience.

**How to Stand Out:**  

This role requires more than strong recruiting fundamentals. We are looking for a technical thinker who can diagnose difficult hiring challenges, test new approaches, and create experiences that make exceptional candidates want to join myKaarma.
Here is an example of the type of scenario we may explore:  

Question:*You need to hire 25 high\-quality software engineers within 90 days, but myKaarma has limited employer\-brand awareness in a highly competitive market. Job postings and traditional outreach are not producing enough qualified candidates. How would you approach the challenge?*  

What will help you stand out: *First, I’d work backward from 25 hires in 90 days to establish the required hiring pace, or takt time, and map the recruiting funnel to identify the constraint.* *I might create a recurring myKaarma Engineering Challenge Day. We would invite a curated group of engineers to solve a realistic, sanitized product problem alongside members of our engineering team. Candidates would experience how we work, meet future colleagues, and demonstrate their technical thinking through the work itself.* *The event would combine assessment, employer branding, and interviews into one structured experience, with standardized evaluation criteria and same\-day decisions. After each event, I would review conversion data and candidate feedback, identify where candidates stalled or disengaged, and improve the next session.* *The goal would be to create a repeatable hiring system that improves speed and quality while giving strong engineers an experience they would talk about, even if they were not hired.*  

We are not looking for one “right” answer. We want to see how you break down the problem, use data to identify constraints, and develop solutions beyond standard recruiting tactics. Ultimately, we want to understand how you would make myKaarma a company talented people actively compete to join. **Key Responsibilities:*** Lead full\-cycle recruiting for software, technology, and other priority roles in India.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, sourcing strategies, interview plans, and selection criteria.
* Build and manage campus recruiting programs, including university partnerships, hiring events, assessments, interview days, and offer coordination.
* Design and execute high\-volume recruiting initiatives such as referral campaigns, pre\-hire testing, recruiting drives, and structured interview days.
* Develop sourcing strategies that create strong, diverse pipelines through direct outreach, referrals, campus relationships, professional networks, and other channels.
* Evaluate candidates for both technical capability and alignment with myKaarma’s hiring standards.
* Maintain recruiting plans, timelines, candidate data, and stakeholder updates across multiple concurrent searches.
* Coordinate interview teams and ensure candidates move through the process efficiently and consistently.
* Use recruiting data to assess pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and improve hiring outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and timely information in our applicant tracking system.
* Represent myKaarma at campus programs, recruiting events, and company locations as needed.
* Help strengthen and standardize recruiting practices as the company scales.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**:* At least five years of recruiting experience, with a meaningful focus on software, technology, and campus hiring.
* Demonstrated success managing high\-volume recruiting programs, such as interview days, campus drives, referral campaigns, or pre\-hire assessment processes.
* Strong understanding of technical roles and the ability to engage credibly with candidates and hiring managers; prior technical education or professional experience is a plus.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to organize complex initiatives, manage deadlines, and coordinate multiple stakeholders.
* Clear, proactive written and verbal communication.
* Strong sourcing, candidate assessment, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Experience managing multiple searches and priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; experience with Rippling is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate recruiting data.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% for campus recruiting, hiring events, or on\-site collaboration.

*We value diverse experiences and backgrounds, so we encourage you to apply if you meet some but not all of the listed qualifications. Skills can be learned—we also value curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to grow.***Total Rewards at myKaarma**


At myKaarma, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that extends beyond the base salary. Our commitment to competitive compensation includes bonuses and benefits that support both personal and professional well\-being:

* **Flexible Work Environment**: We embrace a high\-performance, flexible structure that values freedom and responsibility. Our “Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled” model empowers teams to innovate and continuously improve using data\-driven insights.
* **Health and Wellness**: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, along with wellness and telework stipends.
* **Time Off:** Generous vacation time to recharge and balance life outside work.
* **In\-Office Perks:** Enjoy dog\-friendly offices and unlimited snacks or refreshments onsite.


The starting salary range for this role is \[hiring target], depending on experience and qualifications, reflecting our dedication to competitive industry compensation. Additional details about our Total Rewards package will be shared during recruitment.

Our mission to deliver exceptional solutions to our clients is strengthened by the unique contributions and perspectives of our team members from all backgrounds.
